poses.caption: Sit near the chair edge, extend one leg with the heel grounded and gently draw the toes toward you. Hold 20–30 seconds, then switch legs.

jobs.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male anatomical exercise illustration canonical1390 SEATED CALF STRETCH. ONE STATIC HOLD, exactly ONE full body person on simple stable gray armless chair. Side three-quarter view facing RIGHT, seated near front chair edge, pelvis stays on chair. Working RIGHT leg extended forward nearly straight, RIGHT HEEL firmly rests on floor, toes pulled UP toward shin. Bend forward slightly from hips with neutral long back and relaxed neck, both hands reach the FRONT of right shoe and gently pull toes back, fingers outside shoe. Other left knee bent left foot flat beneath knee for stability. Show credible seated balance, no airborne working heel, no rounded collapse. Exposed working RIGHT posterior calf gastrocnemius RED ONLY, other anatomy grayscale. Detailed crisp fine grayscale exposed muscle contours with realistic limbs hands feet, same premium rendering quality for male/female. Complete opaque BLACK tank front sides back, BLACK mid-thigh shorts fully wrap front sides back seat crotch with real seams and broad fabric folds, no cutaways/transparency or muscle fibers through fabric. Gray/black shoes with visibly upturned toes. Pure WHITE background soft contact shadows generous12percent margins head hands chair and both feet fully inside square image. Reference image rendering STYLE ONLY, ignore bench pushup and chest highlights. No labels text captions arrows or extra panels.
